title: build save with no terminal and no --yes shows the file and saves it: there is no owner gate
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, "Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories": build save writes with no owner gate; --yes is accepted and changes nothing
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts). `jitso build save <id>` shows the build it writes (the draft bytes with `status: approved`) on stdout, every line prefixed with `+ `, then writes `jitso/builds/<id>.yaml`, removes the draft and prints `saved <id>: jitso/builds/<id>.yaml (status approved); the draft is removed`, exit 0. Standard input is not a terminal here and there is no `--yes`: nothing is asked and nothing is refused.
